issues.description: Basic usage example uses a misleading and fragile node lookup pattern.
issues.detail: The snippet `training_node = next(n for n in pipeline.nodes)` returns the first node in pipeline.nodes (which has no guaranteed order in Kedro pipelines, especially with topological sorting). Users copying this with multi-node pipelines will get the wrong node. Should be `pipeline.nodes` filtered by name (e.g. 'train_model_node').

issues.description: ImagePreview example contains unreachable code after return.
issues.detail: In the `preview_correlation_matrix` example, the second `return ImagePreview(...)` for the data URI form is placed after the first `return`, making it dead code even though commented. The structure is confusing — a reader scanning the example sees two returns in one function. Should be split into two separate example functions or use a clearer commented alternative form.

issues.description: Several `node(...)` snippets are shown outside any Pipeline/function context.
issues.detail: The Mermaid customization, text/code preview, and closure examples show bare `node(func=..., preview_fn=...)` calls at module level with no surrounding `Pipeline([...])` or `create_pipeline()` context. New users may copy these as-is into pipeline files and get runtime/import errors. Either wrap in `Pipeline([...])` or annotate as illustrative fragments.

issues.description: Polars example does not import polars, unlike pandas counterpart.
issues.detail: `preview_from_polars(df)` lacks both a type hint on `df` and an `import polars as pl` statement, while the pandas variant just above imports pandas and annotates `df: pd.DataFrame`. Inconsistent and slightly confusing for readers unfamiliar with polars. Adding `import polars as pl` and `df: pl.DataFrame` would match the pattern.

issues.description: Vale dictionary adds duplicate `polars` entry and unnecessary `JSON` heading exception.
issues.detail: `ignore.txt` already contains `Polars` (capitalized) on line 68; adding lowercase `polars` is redundant since Vale's spell check is typically case-insensitive for ignore lists. Similarly, `JSON` in headings.yml may already be covered by general acronym rules. Worth confirming these are actually needed rather than added speculatively.

issues.description: Best practices say to test preview functions but no testing example or pattern is shown.
issues.detail: Item 6 advises 'Test preview functions: Ensure they return valid preview objects' without explaining how — e.g., asserting return type, calling `.to_dict()`, or any pytest pattern. Given this is an experimental API, even a one-line example would significantly help adoption.

review.summary: Documentation-only PR adding a substantial new section to `docs/build/nodes.md` covering the experimental `preview_fn` API on TaskNode, plus two Vale dictionary tweaks. The content is generally clear and well-structured, but several runnable code snippets have issues: an unreliable `next(n for n in pipeline.nodes)` pattern, an ImagePreview example with unreachable post-return code, and multiple bare `node(...)` calls shown outside any Pipeline context. Minor nits on Vale entries and a missing polars import. No security or correctness concerns; mainly clarity and copy-paste-safety fixes.
